mapper.sql: select al.log_id, al.biz_type, al.biz_id, al.action, al.from_status, al.to_status, al.apply_by, al.audit_by, al.audit_time, al.audit_comment, al.create_by, al.create_time, case when al.biz_type = 'library' then l.library_name else t.tag_name end as biz_name from tl_audit_log al left join tl_tag_library l on l.library_id = al.biz_id and l.del_flag = '0' left join tl_tag t on t.tag_id = al.biz_id and t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into tl_audit_log ( biz_type, biz_id, action, from_status, to_status, apply_by, audit_by, audit_time, audit_comment, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{applyBy}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditComment}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
